limitations: Two-class zero-floor chain is periodic; claims about its distribution require Cesaro averaging. A positive sampling floor is a variant of the defining source. No independent validation performed.
scientific_integrity: Exact theorem for one-dimensional normalized inconsistent equations and full projection; proof supplies all-size statements, finite exact checker only corroborates; no proof for higher dimensions or relaxation.
title: Exact stationary bias and spectral inertia of residual-power Kaczmarz on inconsistent scalar systems
